title: The New Neighbourhood
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，然后回答问题。所有题目均为单选题或填空题。填空题答案必须与原文完全一致，且不超过字数限制。选择题请从选项中选出最佳答案。注意：本材料为模拟练习，不是官方雅思考试。
passage:
A
My name is Li Hua. I live in a new flat in Shanghai. The flat is small but clean. There is a big window in my bedroom. There are some plants near the window. I like my new home. There is a small balcony, too. I often sit there in the evening.

B
There is a park near my flat. In the park, there are many trees and some flowers. There is a small lake, too. But there isn't any shop in the park. I often walk there with my dog. The park is very quiet in the morning. There are some birds in the trees. They sing early.

C
There are some shops on my street. There is a supermarket and a bakery. The supermarket is next to the bakery. There is a bus stop in front of the supermarket. There isn't any hospital on my street, but there is a clinic behind the park. The clinic is small. There is a post office between the bakery and the clinic. It is new.

D
My neighbours are friendly. There is a young couple next door. They have a cat. The cat is white. There aren't any children in their flat. I have some friends in the building. We often meet in the garden. The garden is between the two buildings. There are some benches in the garden. I sit there and read books. It is very quiet. There is a small shop near the garden. It sells drinks and snacks. I sometimes buy water there.

grammar.title: There be 句型与可数/不可数名词
grammar.explanation: 我们用“There is + 单数名词”或“There are + 复数名词”来表示某地有某物。可数名词有单复数，如 a plant, some plants；不可数名词没有复数，如 water。肯定句用 some，否定句和疑问句用 any。地点介词如 near, next to, behind, between 用来表示位置。
grammar.example: There are some plants near the window.

options: There is some water in the bottle.
There are some water in the bottle.
There is any water in the bottle.
There are any water in the bottle.
answers: There is some water in the bottle.
questions.explanation: water 是不可数名词，用 There is；肯定句用 some。
questions.evidence: There is some water in the bottle.

options: There isn't any shops on my street.
There aren't any shops on my street.
There isn't some shops on my street.
There aren't some shops on my street.
answers: There aren't any shops on my street.
questions.explanation: shops 是复数可数名词，用 There aren't；否定句用 any。
questions.evidence: There aren't any shops on my street.

questions.prompt: Fill in the blank with ONE word: There ______ a park near my flat.
questions.explanation: a park 是单数，所以用 is。
questions.evidence: There is a park near my flat.

questions.prompt: Fill in the blank with ONE word: There are ______ flowers in the park.
questions.explanation: 肯定句中复数名词前用 some。
questions.evidence: There are some flowers in the park.
